notes.title: A brand new patch 1.1.2 is released!
notes.notes:
Greetings Dieslpunk Builders!

We only recently left Early Access and published the incredible patch 1.1.0 (and the less impressive but still important patch 1.1.1). But we're not slowing down! We have a brand new patch for today which should greatly improve your experience. Check out the changelog below:


 New buildings are added to the 'Fortification' tab in Battle Simulator, including new turrets, barriers, and structures to destroy.
 Turrets placed in Battle Simulator no longer sink into the ground.
 Enemy vehicles in Endless Mode won't spawn if there's an obstacle in the way.
 Fixed an issue that could cause the Endless Mode to (ironically) never end, even after defeat.
 Players are now given a bigger budget when constructing their first flying vehicle in the Campaign Mode.
 The base defense missions on the first map of the Campaign Mode are now easier and unlock more modules.
 Performance is now a bit better on the first four maps.
 Vehicles will no longer be impaired by small rocks or debris, making it a lot easier to traverse difficult terrain!


These new changes should make it a lot easier for new players to start playing Dieselpunk Wars. We're also very excited by the recent additions to the Battle Simulator. You can see an example of what you can do with these new structures by downloading our scenario:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2497661488

You don't need to download any vehicles to check it out. Just subscribe to this scenario on the Steam Workshop, launch the game, start a Battle Simulator on the Valley map and have some fun storming an enemy position!

Did you prepare a scenario you wish to share with your friends? Then all you need to do is post it via Steam Workshop! You can do this by doing the following steps:
[olist]
 Once you're done creating a scenario in Battle Simulator, click on the Save/Load button near the top left corner of the screen.
 Name your scenario and press "Save".
 Click on the recently saved scenario so that it's highlighted with a green frame.
 Press the "Publish to Steam" button and wait for a few seconds while the scenario is being uploaded.
 Once your scenario is on the Steam Workshop, you will receive a notification. You can then add a description to your scenario using the Steam interface.
[/olist]

Thank you for your feedback over the last few days! Most of these recent improvements were made in response to our wonderful community and your valuable comments. We hope that with this new build you'll have even more fun playing Dieselpunk Wars!

With regards
Image Power team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/952240/Dieselpunk_Wars/

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 is out! Check out the changelog!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146173/c79bb06b97636a60b3ae5d1f0799f28fd4eb4066.jpg

Hello Dieselpunk Builders!

As you have probably noticed, Dieselpunk Wars officially left Early Access on the 13th of May. We would like to thank everybody who joined us for the celebration during our release live stream. If you missed it, you can watch a VOD of the live stream here:
[previewyoutube=2MyuRhLfOvs;full][/previewyoutube]

When Dieselpunk Wars left Early Access, we also released the long-awaited patch 1.1.0. Soon after, we also launched a hotfix 1.1.1, addressing some issues with scenario sharing on Steam Workshop. We have been talking about these updates for weeks before the release but we never did share complete patch notes. This post is here to fix that!

Check out the changelog below:


 Added new functionality that allows scenario sharing via Steam Workshop.
 Created a new tab "Fortifications" in Battle Simulator, which allows the players to add buildings to Battle Simulator.
 Reworked Battle Simulator UI to work with new functionalities.
 A vehicle can now be designated as a "Player Vehicle" in the Battle simulator.
 Vessels can now be marked as targets for the Player Vehicle.
 Added a button to copy a selected vehicle in Battle Simulator ('E' by default).
 It's now possible to plan move orders for AI-controlled vehicles in the Battle Simulator.

[hr][/hr] 
Developer comment:
Simply put, all of the above features allow you to create your own missions in Battle Simulator and share them with your friends via Steam Workshop. Scenario sharing works similarly to vehicle sharing. When you start a scenario in which one of the vehicles is a "Player Vehicle", you will take control of the chosen vehicle instead of the usual battle simulation. Your task, as a player, will be to either destroy marked targets or defeat every vehicle on the opposing teams.

As a scenario creator, you can set up elaborate battle plans, position enemy vehicles behind heavy fortifications, and prepare patrol routes for the AI. And then order the player to destroy a heavily guarded convoy or break into a fortified facility. And as a player, all you have to do is download that scenario, open it in Battle Simulator, and have fun!

Just remember that if you share a scenario with custom-made vehicles, you need to publish those vehicles via Steam Workshop too. Otherwise, other players won't be able to use your scenario.
[hr][/hr] 
Now, for the rest of the changelog:

 Added a new map called "Valley", perfect for large-scale vehicles and for custom scenarios in Battle Simulator.
 New blocks were added, including new viewports and Detachable Joints, which you can use to split your vehicle into smaller pieces or merge a few vehicles into one larger vessel.
 Improved vehicle physics.
 It's now possible to modify physics settings, including gravity or air drag, in the Creative Mode.
 Rotors now have an additional function, which allows them to be controlled by a mouse (this can be enabled individually for each rotor in Build Mode).
 Translations have been improved, big thanks to our community for feedback and suggestions regarding these changes!
 And many, many bugfixes...


We've discussed individual parts of this changelog in the days leading up to the patch's release. For more detailed information on any of them, please check out our previous Steam announcements. And if there is anything else that you want to ask us about, feel free to reach out to us in the comments or on our official Discord server.

We can't wait to see the scenarios you come up with!

With regards
Image Power team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/952240/Dieselpunk_Wars/

notes.title: Another feature thats coming in with the final release - Detachable blocks!
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/mU24NY1.jpg

Greetings!

It’s time to show our next feature available in patch 1.1.0! We are thrilled to bring you this one as we're getting closer and closer to the final countdown. Now, let's get to business.

As we mentioned in the last update, we've prepared a joint block that will be added to the game once it leaves Early Access. What's so special about this particular block is that it can split your vehicles into two separate machines or join them together whenever you want to. This creates a whole plethora of possibilities!

https://i.imgur.com/eaIOj8t.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/5yWFVoW.jpg


What makes this feature even cooler is how well this feature synergizes with the "auto-aim" function of certain weapon types. For instance, you could design a part of your vehicle that acts as a deployable turret. Just leave it somewhere on the side and lead your enemies to it - and then open fire on them from two separate directions! This is, of course, just one of many possibilities that now exist, thanks to the joint module. We will let you discover the rest once the update is live ;)

Join our official Discord serverto discuss this update with other players. And let us know your thoughts - we can’t wait to hear from you! 

Best regards,
Image Power Team

notes.title: Dieselpunk Wars contest winners + Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146173/8b07c414fb679401ef1d7ae98d0042b74adb575c.png

Hello, dieselpunk constructors!

Our competition has ended and we’ve got the winners!

Just to remind you, the theme this time was crazy racing machines! We wanted to see machines that can ride on the ground, soar through the skies, or cut through the waves.

We are happy to announce that we decided to give out three awards instead of just one! It was simply too difficult to pick a single winner and we really, really wanted to showcase more than just one competitor.

So without further ado... The main winner of the contest is Helios! The second place goes to WeirdFuturisticAircraft and the third place to Masterscrewer. All three constructors will get their fancy rewards!

Here are the winning screenshots:

Helios
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146173/d6551d40a2b03046da9a586d4ac6c6db51e56abb.jpg

WeirdFuturisticAircraft
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146173/1307edf2580e90c005c32fee143dbcb6e295805a.jpg

Masterscrewer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146173/7d81400cd3412e540fe2d5e8f18777dafa32f8fa.jpg

You can check the rest of them here: 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/952240/screenshots/?snr=2_9_100003_&p=1&browsefilter=mostrecent

Congratulations to our community members! We will send you a Dieselpunk Wars key soon and assign a Skillful Builder role on our Discord server.

Thank you for participating and we encourage you to take a part in our contests in the future. Your skills are amazing and your imagination is impressive. Don’t waste your potential!

New update!

We are also happy to inform you that we released patch 1.0.5. Our main focus was improving the Endless Mode which we still weren't quite satisfied with. Check out the changelog below:

💥 The number of enemies present in the Endless Mode is limited to 5 at a time. If more than five enemies are meant to spawn during a single wave, these enemies will wait until the player destroys one of the opponents. Thanks to this, the player will not be instantly destroyed by a swarm of powerful enemies on higher levels.
💥 It's no longer possible to trigger a double wave spawn by repeatedly pressing the button to start the next wave.
💥 Enemy waves are more consistent. Before, it was possible for more enemies to appear in wave 4 than in wave 5. Now, this shouldn't happen.
💥 We increased the probability of new weapon unlocks after defeating each wave.
💥 If the player is destroyed in the Endless Mode, they will no longer keep access to their previously unlocked parts after restarting the mode.
💥 The module selection hotbar is now reset after the Endless Mode restarts.
💥 We also made various other improvements to the Endless Mode's code so there shouldn't be any further issues with enemy waves not spawning in later stages of this mode.

In the next patch, we will focus on YOUR suggestions. We've been listening to your feedback and we're working on implementing some new mechanics into the game, as well as improving some of the old ones. Stay tuned!

Take care,

notes.title: Dieselpunk Wars Patch 1.0.3
Dieselpunk Wars Patch 1.0.2. - bugfixes and Endless Mode!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146173/6ac0dd6d273d866b0d7f6e86366adbcf3138ccf9.pngHello, dieselpunk constructors! 

It's time for a major update to Dieselpunk Wars!

Now you'll be able to play Endless Mode - the mode where you get to fight waves of increasingly powerful enemies. Do you want to taste dieselpunk survival? Here it comes!

We also added new parts and lots of bugfixes. Further information below. 

Improvements and bug fixes

-> Added the Endless Mode!
We're proud to introduce our fourth game mode to Dieselpunk Wars! This new game mode will let you face waves of progressively tougher enemies. You can fight on any of the four maps! After defeating each wave, your build limit will increase and you will have a chance to upgrade your vehicle with new, random parts. Give this new mode a try and let us know what your high score is!

-> Added 15 new parts! 
You can now create new vehicles using 2 new decorative modules, design new wing setups with 10 more wing parts, make a more aerodynamic vessel with a new hull block, and power your airships and airplanes with 2 new, more powerful propellers! You can check the full list of new parts below;

💥 Improved flying physics, airplanes should now be more stable and wing setup should have a greater impact on how well a vehicle behaves in the air;
💥 Activating field repairs (backspace key by default) will now slightly move your vehicle in the direction you're pointing at, which should help when you get stuck;
💥 Skill Tree and Block Selection Window popouts should no longer display after you dismiss them;
💥 You can now assign weapon groups to numeric keypad;
💥 Fixed the reversed control layout for piston modules;
💥 Gyroscopes should now operate on 100% of their power by default;
💥 Fixed a rare bug, which caused vehicles to flip after activating field repairs;
💥 Added a new, more intuitive camera mode for the Build Mode! You can activate this alternative camera mode by pressing the "/" button while you're in Build Mode. This new camera mode has different controls. You can move your camera around your vehicle by holding the right mouse button and moving your mouse, you can also use the WASD keys for the same effect. The camera will always stay focused on your vehicle.

Full list of new modules:
Deck Passage
Passage with Golden Balustrade
Sloped Wing 
Front Wing 
Flat Wing 
Flat Long Wing 
Wing Back Flap
Front Wing End
Wing Middle End
Curved Front Wing 
Curved Wing Middle
Curved Wing 
Quad Long Triangle 3
Airplane Propeller 
Big Airplane Propeller 

Our community is the best

This patch wouldn’t be possible without your support! Your comments and reviews on the Steam forum as well as discussions on the Discord channel help us focus on what’s most important to the community. You’re helping us make Dieselpunk Wars a better game! Thank you

And we highly encourage you to continue sharing your opinions and suggestions – let us know what you would like to see in Dieselpunk Wars!

Share your thoughts on the Steam forum and in your Steam reviews. Help us improve Dieselpunk Wars!

Thank you for playing!

Cheers,
Image Power Team

notes.title: Dieselpunk Wars Patch 1.0.1 – 25th November
All languages implemented, Steam Workshop hotfix, and backer surveys sent
notes.notes:
We like to keep you on your toes so we prepared a new update for you!

First of all, great news to everyone who struggles with English and wanted to see their game translated to their native language! We finally implemented all remaining translations for Dieselpunk Wars Prologue and now you can enjoy our game in German, French, and simplified Chinese! This brings the total of supported languages to seven, not a bad number!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146173/5d7be9274dd1d0db1e6c587964d306e3c7bc22f0.jpg

In other news, we prepared a small hotfix for everyone playing Dieselpunk Wars Prologue. While this list of changes might not look as impressive as the last one, you have to take into account that we're currently hard at work on Dieselpunk Wars' campaign. Don't worry, we'll continue supporting the Prologue as well as we can and you can expect larger patches once we have more time available! Here are the patch notes:

Improvements:
- Added language support for German, French, and simplified Chinese.
- Tweaked popout background to improve readability.
- You can now update your Steam Workshop vehicles instead of having to upload new versions as separate files.

Fixes:
- Fixed the "Cut through the waves" achievement which wasn't awarded correctly.

Finally, we have one more news for you, although you might already be aware of it - we recently sent out backer surveys to all of our Kickstarter backers! Make sure you check your emails, specifically the one connected to your Kickstarter account. Take a look at the spam folder if you don't see the survey and contact us if it doesn't arrive within the next few days.

Thank you for your continuous support! We'll do our best so that Dieselpunk Wars can live up to your expectations! Check out the Prologue version if you haven't already, as some great vehicles have already been constructed over there! We'll leave you with a little teaser of what one of our players has made ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146173/6d9b58b84b582afed8e69058207867e5a96e6247.png

Until next time!

notes.title: New patch, progress on the campaign, and backer surveys
notes.notes:
Hello there, we prepared a new update for you!

Dieselpunk Wars Prologue launched last week and now everybody can give it a shot! We learned a lot from that and we would like to thank everybody who posted their feedback or Steam reviews! Thanks to your aid we now know exactly what we need to focus on before the full version of Dieselpunk Wars launches. We already started working on incorporating your feedback into both, the full game and the Prologue. As a result, we have a new patch ready for you!

Improvements:
 Added additional quick selection bars to the module panel at the bottom of the screen - you can now toggle between four separate panels and assign different parts to each of them!
 Small tweak to vehicle maneuverability, in preparation for future improvements.
 You can now rotate blocks using the  keys (in addition to the mouse wheel).


Fixes:
 Added missing lines of text in the Russian translation.
 Fixed an issue where English translation would sometimes appear instead of the Russian translation.
 Camera will no longer move when you type something into the search bar in Build Mode.
 Mouse cursor should no longer display when moving the camera in Photo Mode (F11).
 Vehicles can now properly aim and fire at targets above them.


Other:
 We removed the option to change the game language from the main menu due to the numerous issues it caused. You can still set your language via the properties on Steam. Simply right-click on the game in your Steam library, select properties, go to the "Language" tab, and choose the language you want to use.


As for what else is happening in our studio - our team is now focused on finishing the campaign, balancing individual modules, and designing enemy vehicles for the player to face. It's a lot of tedious work but it's nothing we can't handle! We're also working on the behavior of enemy bosses and the way they appear in the cutscenes. We don't want to spoil anything but we might as well show you concept art for one of the most important vehicles in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34146173/6f3b7f6ecf6cc591bf4ee7efb05ad0617505de2e.jpg

Finally, you might be wondering about your backer rewards. Don't worry, we will send you backer surveys regarding your rewards within the coming days! Some of the rewards are already worked on but we will need your input to implement the rest of them. We will also use these surveys to gather your names (or nicknames) to add to the game's credits. So keep an eye out for any new messages you receive!

That's everything for this update. We hope you're doing well! Good luck in your gaming adventures and remember to give Dieselpunk Wars Prologue a try if you haven't done so already ;)
